ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aarti Industries Limited has filed a routine compliance certificate confirming adherence to Regulation 74(5) of SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company's Registrar and Share Transfer Agent affirmed that all share dematerialization requests were processed accurately and within prescribed timelines, ensuring proper record-keeping and regulatory compliance. This report indicates strong operational integrity concerning its share registry processes, with no material impacts or red flags identified.
